expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "probably not into the three-file container/presentational/styles shape you're reaching for out of habit"; "Don't do container/presentational."

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: "Pull each into a custom hook: useSavedCards()... useCheckoutSubmit()..." instead of the layer split.

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one cohesive file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "At ~180 lines... this file is still small and cohesive"; revisit past ~300-400 lines.

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "forces it to open the container, the view, the props type, and the styles, reconcile them... more tokens spent rebuilding context. Locality of behaviour is the thing that makes an AI editor reliable."
